name: SF Infinite Item Split
description: Prevents the selected split amount from being removed from the source stack with a build-profile-verified, split-specific runtime patch.

changelog: Replaces unreliable ECS inventory writes with the split-specific runtime patch used by Shroudtopia.

sections.title: Infinite Item Split
sections.description: Uses the native split-decrement patch. Other item-use operations are unaffected. No ECS component access or extra split settings are required.
